title: Kalaam : Mirza aur Kumail
body:
Nana ne nawaase ne zaher ek sa paaya
<<MINI>>
Ummat ne risalat ka ajr khoob nibhaaya
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Milte hi sam ke Ahmad e Muqtaar pukaare
Aye bhai Ali(a.s) paas zara aao hamaare
Aaye Ali(a.s) to inko ajab haal me paaya
<<MINI>>
Ummat ne risalat ka ajr khoob nibhaaya
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Shabbar(a.s) ko tha jab zehre halahal pila diya
Saidaniyou'n me ek ajab hashr tha bapa
Zainab(s.a) ne roke bas yahi shabbir(a.s) se kaha
<<MINI>>
Ummat ne risalat ka ajr khoob nibhaaya
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Allah ke Nabi ka janaaza tha youn utha
juz Alhebait(a.s) koi bhi shaamil nahi hua
Ummat ne Fatima(s.a) ko baher haal rulaaya
<<MINI>>
Ummat ne risalat ka ajr khoob nibhaaya
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Taboot par Hassan(a.s) ke tha teero'n ka saayebaa'n
Rote the dekh dekh ke ye sarware zamaa'n
pehlu me mohammad(saw) ke bhi dafnaane na diya
<<MINI>>
Ummat ne risalat ka ajr khoob nibhaaya
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Matam karo ek aaj Qayaamat ka roz hai
do Masoomou'n ki aaj shahadat ka roz hai
Aye
Asghari
duayei'n tumhe dengi Syeda(s.a)
<<MINI>>
Ummat ne risalat ka ajr khoob nibhaaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kalaam : Mirza aur Kumail
